content: Okubundi Nyakasane abwîra Yeremiyahu, erhi: J’ogule akabindi k’omubumbi. Mugende mweshi n’abagula b’olubaga n’abakulu omu ba­dâhwa.
Ohuluke ojè ebwa lubanda lwa Ben-Hinomu lubà aha muhango gw’olumvi lw’ababumbi. Ahôla ho wâderhera ebinwa nâkubwîra.

Oderhereho, erhi: Muyumve akanwa ka Nyakasane, mwe mâmi ba Yûda na ninyu mwe muyûbaka omu Yeruzalemu. Kwo, adesire ntya, Nyamubâho w’Emirhwe, Nyamuzinda w’Israheli: Lâbi oku nalêrha obuhanya ahâla, oyu bagubwîra yêshi ayumva enzênene omu marhwiri;

kulya kubà banyâsire, n’ahôla hantu bahahindwîre ha bene, barherekîreho enshangi kuli banyamuzinda bw’obwîhambi b’emahanga, balyâla barhàli bayîshi ôli bo bône ôli b’îshe, ôli abâmi b’emwa Yûda. Ahâla hantu bahabumbire mukò gw’abêru-kwêru.
Bulyâla bayûbasire «orhw’enyanya» rhwa Baali mpu bakazisingônolerakwo bagala bâbo, bakola barherekêra Baali, okwôla ntà mango nakurhegesire, ntà mango nakudesire, ntà mango nakugerêrîze.
Alagi oku ensiku ziyishire, yekudesire Nyakasane, ahâla harhacikâderhwa Tofeti nîsi erhi cibanda ca Ben-Hinomu, ci hâkaziderhwa lubanda lwa cibâgiro.

Yûda na Yeruzalemu nabagukumula­ mwo ihano lyoshi, erhi ahâla harhuma. Nabarhibula n’engôrho omu masù g’abashombanyi bâbo, na kuboko kwa balya barhabalongeza kalamo kwabarhibula, emirhumba yâbo nayihà ebinyunyi by’emalunga n’ebiryanyi bya hano nshi.
Olu lugo nâlujira lubè hantu ha cikango n’olushungûrho, ngasi wâgera afuduke abande n’ehishungûrho
Nabalîsa enyama za bagala bâbo n’eza bali bâbo: balyâna erhi ntanya n’obulagîrire burhuma; ababalagîriza banali abashombanyi bâbo n’abarhabamirira marhî.
Aka kabindi okaberere omu masù g’abâyishikulusa,

onababwîre erhi: «Kw’adesire ntya Nnâmahanga w’Emirhwe: erhi olu lubaga n’olu lugo nâbishangula nka kulya banabera obushanja bw’omubumbi, bwo burhahangwa. Abantu bâbishwa aha Tofeti erhi kubula aha babishirwe kurhuma.
Kwo najira aha hantu ntyo, kanwa ka Nyamubâho, n’abayûbakaho kwo nabajira; olu lugo kwo nalujira lushushe Tofeti.

Enyumpa za Yeruzalemu n’eza abâmi b’emwa Yûda zahemuka, aka ahâla Tofeti, ezi nyumpa zoshi barherekêreraga obubâni oku burhungiri bwâzo ene bàkola bagashâniza emirhwe y’e malunga babulagira n’amamvu oku ibuye mpu bagashânizemwo banyamuzinda b’emwa bene.»
Erhi Yeremiyahu arhenga e Tofeti, Nyakasane ali amurhumire mpu ajire obulêbi, ayimanga emuhanda omu ngo y’aka-Nyamuzinda, ayâkûza olubaga lwoshi erhi:

«Ntya kw’adesire Nnâmahanga w’Emirhwe, Nyamuzinda w’Israheli. Erhi lâbi oku nalêrhera olu lugo n’emirhundu eluliranyire amahanya naluhigiraga goshi, bulyâla bashubire bacikanyi cirhagomba erhi kubula bwayumva ebinwa byâni kurhuma.»
